Mechanism: server-side reaper in the always-on mcp-server scans task_locks for expired locks attributable to a dead session, emits an idempotent re-dispatch signal with a durable-checkpoint pointer; a live session ADOPTS + CONTINUES from the checkpoint (task_board status / handoff / period-keyed artifact) via stale-steal under its own owner_client_session — NOT a restart; poison-task escalation after N retries. Why P1 is prerequisite: owner_client_session is required to attribute an expired lock to a SPECIFIC dead session so a DIFFERENT same-role session can adopt it. ACCEPTED DESIGN CEILING (limit, not defect): zero live sessions = zero execution; the reaper (a tool server, not an agent runtime) only keeps state ADOPTABLE for the next session online.
